searchText: Thanks a ton for going through that PR! Great feedback. I'm currently looking into things needed to get a functional EVM spec. One of the missing bits is Memory Management. I'm starting with this issue: https://github.com/quilt/eth1.0-specs/issues/10 Besides the memory cost calculator we need some utilities to manage memory. I'm planning to build those in subsequent PRs. Any objections?
